svg.title: Synaptane architecture
svg.desc: AI assistants connect over MCP with OAuth 2.1, browsers use the web UI and scripts use the REST API; all three are served by the FastAPI app. A worker runs the nightly AI tidy, agent routines, Git sync, indexing and webhooks. App and worker share PostgreSQL with pgvector and local Git working copies. The worker pulls from and pushes to one Git repository per space (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea…) and calls an optional AI provider.
